args.instructions: Create a monitoring plan for the CR-001 Retail PD Scorecard (binary, tier A, translate strategy). Include monthly KPIs using allowed names: mean_score, realized_rate, predicted_rate, score_psi, realized_gini, realized_recall, and adverse_rate. Define drift detection scenarios for score distribution (score_psi), default rate (realized_rate), and adverse_rate changes. Use only columns present in the model's input frame; do not reference age_band or other missing columns.
